blocks.title: The big idea
blocks.body: A linked list is a chain of nodes made with malloc. Each node holds a value and a pointer to the next node. The last next is NULL. You keep only the head.

blocks.title: The node
Walk the list
blocks.code:
for (node *p = head; p; p = p->next)
    printf("%d\n", p->value);

blocks.title: Pointer steps
items: Insert after p: n->next = p->next; p->next = n
Free all: save next, then free

blocks.title: Array or list?
items: List: cheap insert and delete at a known place
List: slow search, extra pointer per node
Doubly linked: also a prev pointer

blocks.body: Never read a node after freeing it. Every malloc needs one free.
